outcome: risk of emergency admission at the time of delivery
cohort: Pregnant individuals in the Penn Medicine Electronic Health Records database
finding: After adjusting for pregnancy number and previous caesareans, preterm birth, younger maternal age, and Black/African American, Asian, or Other/Mixed race were associated with increased risk of emergency admission at the time of delivery.
mod_finding: The same risk factors were identified for emergency admission at the time of delivery in women who underwent caesarean delivery, with the exception of Asian race and Native Hawaiian/Pacific Islander race, which were not associated with increased or decreased risk, respectively.
